assets.name: cb-blackbox

The pale cyclorama occupies the central back wall from 12 percent to 87 percent of the width and 12 percent to 60 percent of the height. assets.name: cb-dancer-cast
assets.prompt: A production sprite atlas of four diverse adolescent dancers, each shown twice: front view in the top row, matching back view directly underneath. Exactly four equal columns and two equal rows, eight full-body figures total, centered in equal cells with broad empty gutters. All stand in a neutral T pose, arms straight horizontally out at shoulder height, fingers together, feet slightly apart and facing straight forward. Every entire head, fingertips and shoe visible. The four dancers from left to right are: a dark-skinned Black girl with short natural coils and a coral short-sleeve practice shirt, dark burgundy loose dance trousers, cream soft dance shoes; a light-skinned boy with short wavy brown hair and a sky-blue short-sleeve shirt, navy trousers, cream shoes; a medium-brown South Asian girl with black hair in a compact bun, a sunflower-yellow short-sleeve shirt, dark olive loose trousers, cream shoes, fuller body; a light-brown boy with short dark hair, a pink short-sleeve shirt, plum trousers, cream shoes, a modestly visible sports prosthesis below his left knee. Plain solid pure green #00FF00 background everywhere between figures. Natural friendly faces, comfortable modest rehearsal clothing, equal importance and confident bearing. Front and back clothing and body proportions match exactly. Symmetric level shoulders, straight vertical torso, hands separated from torso for articulated animation. No cast shadows, no props, no floor, no grid lines, no writing. This single neutral-pose atlas will be cut into painted articulated parts so all dance poses remain driven by precise joint data.
assets.status: drawn; neutral articulated cast with front/back views
